patch_description: Inspired by the greedy cost-sampling construction and insertion local search from prior programs, this version implements a fundamentally different pipeline: (1) a randomized *regret-style* greedy that, instead of picking the single best next transaction, samples several candidates and picks one weighted toward low incremental cost, producing more diverse starting solutions; (2) a hybrid local search alternating **swap moves** (exchange two transaction positions — a move type prior programs never used, which explores a different neighborhood than insertion) with **insertion moves**; (3) a late-acceptance/annealing acceptance criterion allowing occasional uphill moves to escape local optima, then a final greedy best-improvement polish. The 100s time budget is kept, with restarts.
